tool.name: HyphAeon-Phenotype
tool.description: Directional phenotype-genotype association & PARS signature extraction (PhyloWAS)
tool.command: @SYMLINK_FILES@ hyphaeon phenotype -a input.$input_file.extension @INPUT_TREE@ @MODEL_SOURCE@ #if $phenotype_source.source_type == "preset": -p '$phenotype_source.preset' #elif $phenotype_source.source_type == "manual": -fg '$phenotype_source.foreground' #if $phenotype_source.background: -bg '$phenotype_source.background' #end if #elif $phenotype_source.source_type == "file": -pf '$phenotype_source.phenotype_file' -tc '$phenotype_source.trait_col' -sc '$phenotype_source.species_col' #if $phenotype_source.continuous: --continuous #end if #end if --permulations $permulations --min-taxa $min_taxa --alpha $alpha --n-permutations $n_permutations #if $max_perm_p: --max-perm-p $max_perm_p #end if @OUTPUTS@

param.name: source_type
param.label: Phenotype definition
param.help: How to define the foreground (trait-positive) and background (trait-negative) taxa

param.label: Curated phenotype preset
param.help: Pre-defined foreground/background taxon sets for well-studied convergent phenotypes
param.option: Marine Mammal Transition & Deep Diving Hypoxia

param.label: Foreground taxa
param.help: Comma-separated list or regex pattern of foreground (trait-positive) taxa. Patterns support wildcards, e.g. 'turTru*' matches all taxa starting with 'turTru'.

param.label: Background taxa (optional)
param.help: Comma-separated list or regex pattern of background (control) taxa. If omitted, all non-foreground taxa are used as background.

param.label: Phenotype metadata file
param.help: CSV or TSV file mapping taxa to trait values

param.label: Trait column name
param.help: Name of the column containing trait values (binary 0/1 or continuous)

param.label: Species column name
param.help: Name of the column containing taxon names matching the alignment headers

param.label: Continuous trait
param.help: Treat trait values as continuous phylogenetic contrasts rather than binary foreground/background

param.label: Number of permulations
param.help: Number of Brownian motion phylogenetic permulations for empirical p-values (RERconverge null model). 0 = parametric p-values only.

param.label: Minimum taxa per site
param.help: Minimum number of sequenced taxa required per site to include in the association test

param.label: FDR significance threshold
param.help: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR threshold for declaring significant associations

param.label: Monte Carlo permutations
param.help: Number of random K-site subset Monte Carlo permutations for trait sector significance testing

param.label: Max permutation p-value (optional)
param.help: Maximum permutation p-value threshold to retain trait sectors (default: None, retain all C(S) >= 0.45)

tool.help:
HyphAeon Phenotype: Directional Phenotype-Genotype Association ================================================================
**What question does this method answer?**
Which codon sites in a gene alignment are significantly associated with a binary or continuous phenotypic trait across species? (e.g., which sites are associated with the evolution of echolocation, marine adaptation, or drug resistance?)
**How it works**
HyphAeon performs a phylogenetically-aware genome-wide association study (PhyloWAS / phylowas) by comparing the selection signatures at each site between foreground (trait-positive) and background (trait-negative) taxa. The method uses the transformer's learned evolutionary embeddings to detect directional shifts associated with the trait, with optional Brownian-motion permulations for empirical p-values (RERconverge null model).
**Defining the phenotype**
Three options:
1. **Curated preset**: select from a list of well-studied convergent phenotypes (echolocation, marine adaptation, fossoriality, hibernation, longevity, high-altitude hypoxia, cardenolide resistance, dim-light vision). Presets include pre-defined foreground and background taxon sets. 2. **Manual**: specify foreground and (optionally) background taxa as comma-separated lists or wildcard patterns (e.g., ``turTru*``). 3. **File**: upload a CSV/TSV metadata file mapping taxon names to trait values. Supports both binary (0/1) and continuous traits.
**Inputs**
- An in-frame codon alignment (FASTA or NEXUS) - An optional phylogenetic tree - A phenotype definition (preset, manual, or file)
**Outputs**
- **JSON**: full per-site association results including LRT, p-values, FDR-adjusted q-values, and PARS signatures - **CSV**: tabular per-site summary suitable for Manhattan-style plots
